examples.text: asantaṃ bhāvanam'iccheyya, purekkhārañ'ca bhikkhusu, āvāsesu ca issariyaṃ, pūjā parakulesu ca.
itthiṃ soṇḍiṃ vikiraṇiṃ, purisaṃ vā'pi tādisaṃ, issariyasmiṃ ṭhāpeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke, kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ. kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke, kiṃsu lokasmim'abbudaṃ.
vaso issariyaṃ loke, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ, kodho satthamalaṃ loke, corā lokasmim'abbudā.
accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo'haṃ pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ issariyakāraṇā jīvitā voropesiṃ.

13905.meaning1: having power as ultimate goal; with rulership as ultimate purpose
13905.meaning2: whose ideal or aim is power or kingship
13905.commentary: (ANa) issariyapariyosānā'ti rajj'ābhisekapariyosānā. abhisekañ'hi patvā te pariyosānappattā nāma honti. iminā nayena sabbattha attho veditabbo.

13906.meaning1: power of authority; strength of rulership

examples.text: katamena ekena balena? issariyabalena abhibhūtaṃ mātugāmaṃ n'eva rūpabalaṃ tāya'ti, na bhogabalaṃ tāya'ti, na ñātibalaṃ tāya'ti, na puttabalaṃ tāya'ti, na sīlabalaṃ tāyatīti.

13907.meaning1: power of mental mastery; strength of self-control
13907.commentary: (PM) katamaṃ issariyabalaṃ? kāmacchandaṃ pajahanto nekkhammavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetī'ti, issariyabalaṃ. byāpādaṃ pajahanto abyāpādavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetī'ti, issariyabalaṃ. thinamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetī'ti, issariyabalaṃ… sabbakilese pajahanto arahattamaggavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetī'ti, issariyabalaṃ. idaṃ issariyabalaṃ.

13909.meaning1: intoxicated with the vanity of power; drunk with authority

examples.text: yāni tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddh'āvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ pathavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ rājakaraṇīyāni bhavanti, tesu khv'āhaṃ, eta'r'ahi ussukkam'āpanno'ti.

13911.commentary: (DNa) issariyavossaggenā'ti itthiyo hi mahālatāsadisam'pi ābharaṇaṃ labhitvā bhattaṃ vicāretuṃ alabhamānā kujjhanti, kaṭacchuṃ hatthe ṭhapetvā tava ruciyā karohī'ti bhattagehe vissaṭṭhe sabbaṃ issariyaṃ vissaṭṭhaṃ nāma hoti, evaṃ karaṇenā'ti attho. (DNt) issariyavossaggenā'ti ettha yādiso issariyavossaggo gihiniyā anucchaviko, taṃ dassento bhattagehe vissaṭṭhe'ti āha.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, sammānanāya anavamānanāya anaticariyāya issariyavossaggena alaṅ'kār'ānuppadānena.

13912.meaning1: supreme sovereign power; (or) authority and dominion

13913.commentary: (MNa) issaṃ bandhatī'ti yavakalāpaṃ bandhanto viya yathā na nassati evaṃ bandhitvā viya ṭhapeti.

examples.text: issāmanikā kho pana hoti, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu issati upadussati issaṃ bandhati.

13914.commentary: (ANa) usūyanalakkhaṇā issā. (MNa) parasampattikhīyanalakkhaṇā issā, tassā akkhamanalakkhaṇā vā, tattha anabhiratirasā, tato vimukhabhāvapaccupaṭṭhānā.

examples.text: atītayobbano poso, āneti timbarutthaniṃ, tassā issā na supati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti, makkhissa makkho appahīno hoti, paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti
na c'āpi sotthi bhattāraṃ, iss'ācārena rosaye, bhattu ca garuno sabbe, paṭipūjeti paṇḍitā.

13916.meaning1: full of envy; overwhelmed by jealousy
13916.meaning2: full of envy; jealous by nature
13916.commentary: (SNa) sā issāpakatā sapattiṃ aṅgārakaṭāhena okirī'ti tassa kira rañño ekā nāṭakinī aṅgārakaṭāhaṃ samīpe ṭhapetvā gattato udakaṃ puñchati, pāṇinā ca sedaṃ karoti. rājā'pi tāya saddhiṃ kathañ'ca karoti, parituṭṭh'ākārañ'ca dasseti. aggamah'esī taṃ asahamānā issāpakatā hutvā acirapakkantassa rañño taṃ aṅgārakaṭāhaṃ gahetvā tassā upari aṅgāre okiri. sā taṃ kammaṃ katvā tādisaṃ'y'eva vipākaṃ paccanubhavituṃ petaloke nibbattā.

examples.text: sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamah'esī ahosi. sā issāpakatā sapattiṃ aṅgārakaṭāhena okiri …. pañcamaṃ.

13917.meaning1: obsessed by jealousy; consumed with envy

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ maccheramala-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati. majjh'anhikasamayaṃ issāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati. sāy'anhasamayaṃ kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati.

13918.meaning1: jealousy and stinginess; envy and selfishness

examples.text: issāmacchariyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, piy'āppiya-nidānaṃ piy'āppiya-samudayaṃ piy'āppiya-jātikaṃ piy'āppiya-pabhavaṃ, piy'āppiye sati issāmacchariyaṃ hoti, piy'āppiye asati issāmacchariyaṃ na hotī'ti.

13919.meaning1: with jealousy and stinginess as fetter; having envy and selfishness as a bond
13919.commentary: (DNa) issāmacchariyasaṃyojanā'ti parasampattikhīyanalakkhaṇā issā, attasampattiyā parehi sādhāraṇabhāvassa asahanalakkhaṇaṃ macchariyaṃ, issā ca macchariyañ'ca saṃyojanaṃ etesan'ti issāmacchariyasaṃyojanā. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo. vitthārato pana issāmacchariyāni abhidhamme vuttān'eva.

examples.text: issāmacchariyasaṃyojanā kho, devānam'inda, devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye c'aññe santi puthukāyā, te, averā adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjā viharemu averino'ti iti ca nesaṃ hoti, atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjā viharanti saverino'ti.

13920.commentary: (ANa) issāmanikā'ti issāya sampayuttacittā. iminā nayena sabbattha attho veditabbo.

examples.text: issāmanikā kho pana hoti, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu issati upadussati issaṃ bandhati.

13921.meaning1: stain of jealousy; impurity of envy

examples.text: dussīlo ca hoti, dussīlyamalañ'c'assa appahīnaṃ hoti, issukī ca hoti, issāmalañ'c'assa appahīnaṃ hoti, maccharī ca hoti, maccheramalañ'c'assa appahīnaṃ hoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male appahāya yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
imesam'pi hi, bho gotama, issāsānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, issatthe.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
na c'āpi sotthi bhattāraṃ, issāvādena rosaye, bhattu ca garuno sabbe, paṭipūjeti paṇḍitā.

13926.meaning1: with a mind devoid of jealousy

examples.text: yā nūn'āhaṃ, bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ anissāmanikā ahosiṃ, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu na issiṃ na upadussiṃ na issaṃ bandhiṃ, s'āhaṃ, bhante, eta'r'ahi mahesakkhā.

examples.text: na vākkaraṇamattena, vaṇṇapokkharatāya vā, sādhurūpo naro hoti, issukī maccharī saṭho.
upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti, makkhissa makkho appahīno hoti, paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti
yo n'ājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ puppham'iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
abalā naṃ balīyanti, maddant'enaṃ parissayā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, nāvaṃ bhinnam'iv'odakaṃ.
442, 448. ivaṇṇ'āgamo vā.

examples.text: sabbehi dhātūhi yamhi paccaye pare ivaṇṇ'āgamo hoti vā. karīyate, karīyati, gacchīyate, gacchīyati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? kayyate.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
sare'ty'adhikāro. pana ime pana ime'ti-iha sarā lopaṃ itv'eva.

labha'icc'etāya dhātuyā ī iṃnaṃ vibhattīnaṃ ttha tthaṃ ādesā honti, dhātv'antassa lopo ca. alattha, alatthaṃ.

13939.meaning1: (gram) iṃsu; verbal ending of the aorist 3rd person plural

examples.text: 504, 470. sabbato uṃ iṃsu.
sabbehi dhātūhi uṃvibhattissa iṃsuādeso hoti. upasaṅkamiṃsu, nisīdiṃsu

brū'icc'etāya dhātuyā īkār'āgamo hoti timhi vibhattimhi. bravīti.

13944.commentary: (BVa) sabb'ītiyo'ti entī'ti ītiyo, sabbā ītiyo sabb'ītiyo, upaddavā.

examples.text: sabb'ītiyo vivajjantu, soko rogo vinassatu, mā te bhavantv'antarāyā, phusa khippaṃ bodhim'uttamaṃ.

13946.meaning1: such; of such kind; like this
13946.commentary: (UDa) īdiso ca īdiso cā'ti evarūpo ca evarūpo ca

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa vassaṃvuṭṭhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho, api ca suto'y'eva me so bhagavā, īdiso ca īdiso cā'ti.
sataṃ āsi ayosaṅkū, sabbe paccattavedanā, īdiso nirayo āsi, yattha dūsī apaccatha.

13947.meaning1: such; of such kind; with such qualities
13947.meaning2: of such a kind; like this
13947.construction:
imaṃ > ī + disa + ka
īdisa + ka

examples.text: taṃ lakkhaṇaññū bahavo samāgatā, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, uṇṇā ca lomā ca yathā susaṇṭhitā, upavattatī īdisakaṃ bahujjano.

13948.meaning1: (gram) īya suffix; used to form denominative verbs

examples.text: nāmato upamānā ācār'atthe ca īyapaccayo hoti. achattaṃ chattam'iva ācarati, chattīyati, aputtaṃ puttam'iva ācarati, puttīyati.

13949.meaning1: (gram) īya suffix; used to form denominative verbs

examples.text: nāmato upamānā ācār'atthe ca īyapaccayo hoti. achattaṃ chattam'iva ācarati, chattīyati, aputtaṃ puttam'iva ācarati, puttīyati.
nāmamhā attano icch'atthe īyapaccayo hoti. attano pattam'icchati, pattīyati. evaṃ vatthīyati, parikkhārīyati, cīvarīyati, dhanīyati, ghaṭīyati.

13957.synonym: adhipa, adhipati, adhibhū, ādhipati, ina, inda, issara, nāyaka, pati, bhattar, rāja, vasī, sāmī
13957.commentary: (DNt) īsati abhibhavatī'ti īso, mahanto īso maheso (APt) īsa issariye, a, īso.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhānavantānaṃ yadidaṃ vaṅg'īso.
vāg'īso vādisūdano'ti vādīnaṃ paṇḍitajanānaṃ īso padhāno vādīso'ti vattabbe da-kārassa ga-kāraṃ katvā evaṃ vuttan'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sobhati maccho gaṅgeyyo, atho sobhati yāmuno, catuppadoyaṃ puriso, nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo, īsak'āyata gīvo ca, sabb'eva atirocati.

13959.meaning1: slightly sloping; at a slight angle
13959.meaning2: slanting slightly, at a slight angle
13959.commentary: (MNa) īsakaṃpoṇe'ti rath'īsā viya uṭṭhahitvā ṭhite. (MNt) īsakaṃ poṇe'ti majjhe uccaṃ hutvā īsakaṃ poṇe, na antantena vaṅke. ten'āha, rath'īsā viya uṭṭhahitvā ṭhite'ti.

examples.text: tassa taṃ uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti. seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakapoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti, na saṇṭhanti
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakam'poṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti

13961.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of īsaka

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti

seyyathā'pi, udāyi, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddho īsakaṃ'y'eva kāyaṃ sannāmetvā tāni bandhanāni saṃchinditvā saṃpadāletvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti

13964.meaning1: (of a carriage, chariot, or plough) pole; shaft
13964.meaning2: pole of a plough or a carriage
13964.commentary: (SNPa) īsā'ti yuganaṅgalasandhārikā dāruyaṭṭhi. yathā hi brāhmaṇassa īsā yuganaṅgalaṃ sandhāreti, evaṃ bhagavato'pi hirī lokiyalokuttarapaññāsaṅkhātaṃ yuganaṅgalaṃ sandhāreti hiriyā asati paññāya abhāvato. yathā ca īsāpaṭibaddhaṃ yuganaṅgalaṃ kiccakaraṃ hoti acalaṃ asithilaṃ, evaṃ hiripaṭibaddhā ca paññā kiccakārī hoti acalā asithilā abbokiṇṇā ahirikena. ten'āha hirī īsā'ti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā rath'īsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rath'īsaṃ'y'eva ajjhomaddati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo assadoso.
saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.

13965.meaning2: having tusks as long as a plough-pole; i.e. elephant

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti

ye dhammā abrāhmaṇakārakā te dhamme samādāya vattamānā evam'āhaṃsu, indam'avhayāma, somam'avhayāma, varuṇam'avhayāma, īsānam'avhayāma, pajāpatim'avhayāma, brahmam'avhayāma, mahiddhim'avhayāma, yamam'avhayāmā'ti.

13967.commentary: (SNa) īsāmukhenā'ti rathassa īsāmukhena. yathā kulāvake īsāmukhaṃ na sañcuṇṇeti, evaṃ iminā īsāmukhena te parivajjaya. so hi ratho puññapaccayanibbatto cakkavāḷapabbate'pi sinerumhi'pi sammukhībhūte vinivijjhitvā'va gacchati na sajjati, ākāsagatasadisen'eva gacchati. sace tena simbalivanena gato bhaveyya, yathā mahāsakaṭe kadalivanamajjhena vā eraṇḍavanamajjhena vā gacchante sabbavanaṃ vibhaggaṃ nimmathitaṃ hoti, evaṃ tam'pi simbalivanaṃ bhaveyya.

examples.text: kulāvakā mātali simbalismiṃ, īsāmukhena parivajjayassu, kāmaṃ cajāma asuresu pāṇaṃ, māyime dijā vikulāvakā ahesun'ti.
seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso muñjamhā īsikaṃ pavāheyya. tassa evam'assa ayaṃ muñjo, ayaṃ īsikā, añño muñjo, aññā īsikā, muñjamhā tv'eva īsikā pavāḷhā'ti.
aniggataratanake'ti mahā-īsī sayanigharā anikkhantā hoti, ubho vā anikkhantā honti.

so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā khar'ājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā magavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ pavisati, saddhiṃ mahā-īsiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.

13982.commentary: (MNa) tattha ukkacelāyan'ti evaṃnāmake nagare. tasmiṃ kira māpiyamāne rattiṃ gaṅgāsotato maccho thalaṃ patto. manussā celāni telapātiyaṃ temetvā ukkā katvā macchaṃ gaṇhiṃsu. nagare niṭṭhite tassa nāmaṃ karonte amhehi nagaraṭṭhānassa gahitadivase cel'ukkāhi maccho gahito'ti ukkacelā-tv'ev'assa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aciraparinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.

13983.meaning1: prominent; elevated; in a high position (in)

examples.text: y'āhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho, rañño aṅgassa paddhagū, sv'ājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho, soṇo dukkhassa pāragū.
tayo pattassa vaṇṇā ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
daṇḍo nāma majjhimassa purisassa catuhattho daṇḍo. tato ukkaṭṭho adaṇḍo, omako adaṇḍo.

13986.commentary: (THIa) ukkaṭṭhamajjhimā'ti paṇītā c'eva majjhimā ca. tesu vā asaṅkhatā hīnā jātisaṅkhatā ukkaṭṭhā, ubhayavimissitā majjhimā. hīnehi vā chand'ādīhi nibbattitā hīnā, majjhimehi majjhimā, paṇītehi ukkaṭṭhā. akusalā dhammā vā hīnā, lok'uttarā dhammā ukkaṭṭhā, itarā majjhimā.

examples.text: ye keci vaḍḍha saṅkhārā, hīnā ukkaṭṭhamajjhimā, aṇū'pi aṇumatto'pi, vanatho me na vijjati.

13987.commentary: (MNa) accukkaṭṭhan'ti yo hi yāva hanukaṭṭhito ukkhipitvā pārupati, tassa accukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma hoti… yo'pi ubhato ukkhipitvā udaraṃ vivaritvā yāti, tassa'pi accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti.

13988.meaning1: high-class disease; rich people's disease; i.e. diabetes

13989.commentary: (MNa) ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharatī'ti ettha ukkāti dīpikā, tañ'ca nagaraṃ, maṅgaladivaso sukhaṇo sunakkhattaṃ mā atikkamī'ti rattim'pi ukkāsu ṭhitāsu māpitattā ukkaṭṭhā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.

13992.meaning1: is postponed; is put off; is delayed

examples.text: pariyiṭṭhāya vassikasāṭikāya vassaṃ ukkaḍḍhiyyati, nivatthāya vassikasāṭikāya vassaṃ ukkaḍḍhiyyati, dhovitvā nikkhipitabbaṃ, samaye nivāsetabbaṃ, acchinnacīvarassa, naṭṭhacīvarassa, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

13994.meaning1: sick (of); is fed up (with); is dissatisfied (with); is annoyed (with); up to the neck (with)

examples.text: ukkaṇṭhāmi sarīrena, bhaven'amhi anatthiko, so'yaṃ bhijjissati kāyo, añño ca na bhavissati.

13995.commentary: (DNa) ukkaṇṭhanā paritassanā'ti jhānabhūmiyaṃ ṭhitassa anabhirati-ukkaṇṭhanā vā bhayaparitassanā vā n'atthi, brahmuno pana āgamanapatthanā āgamanataṇhā ahū'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho, bho, mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena ahu'd'eva ukkaṇṭhanā ahu paritassanā

13996.meaning1: being sick (of); being fed up (with); being dissatisfied (with); being annoyed (with); being up to the neck (with)

13998.commentary: (THa) ukkaṇṭhitopi na vase'ti yasmiṃ āvāse vasantassa me bhojanasappāy'ālābhena adhikusalesu dhammesu ukkaṇṭhā anabhirati uppajjati, tattha ukkaṇṭhito'pi vasāmi'y'eva itarasappāyalābhena na pakkame na pakkamāmi.

examples.text: ukkaṇṭhito'pi na vase, ramamāno'pi pakkame, na tv'ev'ānatthasaṃhitaṃ, vase vāsaṃ vicakkhaṇo'ti.
coro'pi tasmiṃ samaye dīgharattaṃ dubbhojanena ca dukkhaseyyāya ca ukkaṇṭhito hoti. kittakā pan'ānena manussā māritā'ti?

13999.commentary: (SNa) ukkaṇṭakena nāmā'ti evaṃnāmakena rogena. so kira sītakāle uppajjati. tasmiṃ uppanne sakalasarīrato lomāni patanti, sakalasarīraṃ nillomaṃ hutvā, samantato phuṭati, vātabbhāhatā vaṇā rujjanti. yathā ummattakasunakhena daṭṭho puriso anavaṭṭhito'va bhamati, evaṃ tasmiṃ uppanne bhamitabbo hoti, asukaṭṭhāne sotthi bhavissatī'ti na paññāyati.

examples.text: eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇḍakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho. so yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati. yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati.
